title: Using machine learning to predict persecutory beliefs based on aetiological models of delusions identified in a systematic literature search.
summary: A cross-sectional evaluation found that literature-derived predictors explained about 31% of measured variation in persecutory beliefs.
ai_technology: Random forests assessed a prespecified literature-derived predictor set with nested cross-validation.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: A 336-person study quantified how well competing theoretical predictors explained measured beliefs.
evidence.unknown: Nested cross-validation, validated questionnaire scores and measured behavioral inputs; cross-sectional self-report design limits causal and external inference.
evidence.ai_role: Random forests assessed a prespecified literature-derived predictor set with nested cross-validation.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
